standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of closedness of a constructible subset through its preimage in a finite cover
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2923-2934)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces closedness of the image to a condition on the pieces of a finite cover of the target.

core_obligations: Cover the target: take a finite cover of the target by pieces on which the closedness condition can be tested (proof lines 2922-2932)

Test on the pieces: for each member of the cover the preimage of the image is the image of the preimage, which is closed by quasi-compactness of the closed fibres, so the condition holds on each piece (proof lines 2933-2940)
Conclude: the characterization gives closedness of the image (proof lines 2940-2941)
proof_roadmap: 取目标的有限覆盖 {U_i}，只需在每个 U_i 上验证 f^{-1}(像) 的条件。
在该成员上，f^{-1}(像) 的限制等于某个闭集（由纤维准紧），故条件成立。
由可构造子集闭性的刻画得像是闭的。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the image of a quasi-compact space under a map whose image is constructible and whose fibres are closed is closed (author lemma at source lines 2915-2920, label lemma-closed-constructible-image). The proof (source lines 2922-2941) tests the closedness characterization of a constructible subset on a finite cover of the target and uses quasi-compactness of the fibres on each piece (proof lines 2922-2940). The test on the pieces of the cover is the content. H3.
